messages:
Priya (Legal): quick flag from privacy review: when users bulk-edit retention we need clear audit records and CSV exports showing both previous and new values. Right now CSV only has new.
Marco (PM): good catch. We should include columns: resource_id, region, previous_retention_days, new_retention_days, actor, timestamp, timezone.
Lena (Design): UI-wise, in the bulk modal we show a small preview list of affected resources. Could we add a checkbox: 'Include previous retention in audit export' so legal teams can opt-in?
Diego (Frontend): backend needs to send prev values anyway if we want to export it. That adds payload size but fine. We should default the checkbox to ON for compliance tenants.
Eli (Security): default ON sounds right. Also, audit events themselves should be explicit: not just 'Retention updated' but 'Applied retention policy: 90d to 12 datasets (previously 30d) in us-west-2'. Include region ID.
Tara (A11y): accessibility nit: bulk modal focus trap currently doesn't announce how many items will be changed. Need an aria-live region with a summary like 'Applying retention to 12 items in us-west-2'.
Priya (Legal): also include a reason field in the modal (optional) that becomes an audit field in CSV and logs. Helps for retention justifications.
Marco (PM): product decision: make 'reason' optional but suggest placeholder text: 'e.g., project archive, regulatory requirement'.
Lena (Design): copy for the toast after bulk apply: we currently show 'Changes saved'. Suggest 'Retention updated for 12 items — audit exported' (if they checked export) or 'Retention updated for 12 items'. Keep toast short; link to audit row in console for details.
Diego (Frontend): toast length constraint acknowledged. We can link to the audit detail drawer: 'View details' CTA. Implementation: toast should be announced to SRs via polite aria-live.
Tara (A11y): toast voice: use aria-live="polite" for success to avoid interrupting screen readers. Also ensure focus isn't stolen.
Eli (Security): CSV header naming: prefer snake_case stable headers: resource_id, resource_type, region_id, prev_retention_days, new_retention_days, actor_email, actor_id, action_timestamp_utc, reason. Also always include UTC timestamps.
Priya (Legal): actor_email is required for legal audits. If actor is a service account, include both id and email in separate columns.
Marco (PM): UX question: when a region mismatch exists (some selected resources are multi-region), what do we show? Do we warn?
Lena (Design): show a subtle banner at top of modal: 'Selected items span multiple regions. Audit records will include the region of each resource.' Use amber tone and ensure contrast.
Diego (Frontend): contrast nit: amber #FFDFB5 on white fails for text. Use darker amber #FFB84D or include a left icon to increase visual affordance.
Tara (A11y): don't rely on color. Add role="status" on the banner and an icon with aria-hidden="true", plus readable text.
Eli (Security): also consider scoping the API call: if user picks 'Apply to children', audit should record which resources were implicitly affected. We should set a flag column 'cascade_applied'.
Priya (Legal): yes, that must be explicit. Add cascade_applied true/false in CSV.
Marco (PM): mobile flow: the preview list collapses to '12 items, tap to expand'. Need to ensure keyboard users can expand without losing context.
Diego (Frontend): will ensure the expand button is reachable via tab and has aria-expanded. We'll also add a 'select all' label that reads 'Select all 12 items on this page' for screen readers.
Lena (Design): audit log microcopy: use 'Applied retention policy' vs 'Changed retention' — 'Applied' reads like a deliberate policy action.
Eli (Security): agree. Full event example: 'Applied retention policy: 90 days (prev: 30 days) to 12 resources — eu-central-1; actor: priya@example.com; ts: 2024-05-02 18:03 UTC; reason: project archive; cascade_applied: true'.
Tara (A11y): final a11y ask: when opening CSV exports from the console, ensure the download link has aria-describedby with file schema summary. So screen readers know what columns are included before download.
ops-bot: Scheduled job: retention-export-schema-v2 deployed to staging at 2024-05-03T02:00Z. Logs: https://ops.redwood/app/logs/retention-export-v2
Diego (Frontend): I'll open a PR for modal changes + toast announcements and wire up the CSV headers with backend. ETA Friday.
Marco (PM): thanks team. Can we review staging Friday afternoon? Priya, can legal do a quick pass then?
Priya (Legal): yes, I'll review Friday. Thanks all for the quick turnaround. :white_check_mark:
